content.text:
I can't draw Sonic, since he's a protected character, but here's an original speedster instead: a comet-tailed fox sprinting with motion streaks.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 260" width="400" height="260">
  <rect width="400" height="260" fill="#fdf6e3"/>
  <!-- motion streaks -->
  <g stroke="#f4a261" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="20" y1="110" x2="120" y2="110"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="140" x2="130" y2="140"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="170" x2="110" y2="170"/>
  </g>
  <!-- comet tail -->
  <path d="M150 150 Q90 120 60 150 Q100 160 150 165 Z" fill="#e76f51"/>
  <path d="M150 155 Q110 140 90 155 Q120 160 150 162 Z" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="155" rx="55" ry="32" fill="#2a9d8f" transform="rotate(-10 200 155)"/>
  <ellipse cx="205" cy="162" rx="30" ry="16" fill="#e9f5f2" transform="rotate(-10 205 162)"/>
  <!-- legs mid-stride -->
  <g stroke="#264653" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="175" y1="178" x2="145" y2="210"/>
    <line x1="230" y1="175" x2="265" y2="205"/>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="140" cy="214" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#264653"/>
  <ellipse cx="270" cy="209" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#264653"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="265" cy="115" r="34" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
  <polygon points="250,88 242,55 270,82" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
  <polygon points="275,84 290,52 295,90" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
  <polygon points="252,85 247,66 264,82" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <path d="M290 115 L325 125 L292 135 Z" fill="#e9f5f2"/>
  <circle cx="324" cy="125" r="5" fill="#264653"/>
  <!-- goggles -->
  <rect x="248" y="100" width="40" height="16" rx="8" fill="#264653"/>
  <circle cx="276" cy="108" r="6" fill="#8ecae6"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M240 135 Q265 145 285 135 L282 145 Q262 155 238 145 Z" fill="#e63946"/>
  <path d="M240 140 Q210 130 190 115 Q215 140 238 148 Z" fill="#e63946"/>
</svg>
```

Want me to save it to a file in the repo or tweak the colors or pose?
